name: Linear Pattern Detection
description: Detects unnatural linear patterns in image
algorithm: Linear Pattern Detection — Pixel-Level Spatial Analysis
mechanism:
This method performs pixel-level spatial analysis to detect AI-generated artifacts:

1. **Image Preprocessing**: The input image is loaded and converted to appropriate color space for analysis.

2. **Feature Extraction**: Detects unnatural linear patterns in image. The algorithm extracts relevant pixel-level features across the image grid.

3. **Pattern Analysis**: Statistical measures are computed from extracted features to identify irregularities.

4. **Anomaly Detection**: Results are compared against baselines from authentic camera images vs AI-generated images.

5. **Score Computation**: A confidence score (0-100) is calculated based on the degree of detected anomalies.
parameters:
Analysis type: pixel
Media: image
Input: Raw pixel data / image file
Output: Confidence score (0-100)
Processing: Client-side Canvas API
Color spaces: RGB, Grayscale as applicable
accuracy: Moderate to High — 70-90% standalone accuracy. Performance is highest on uncompressed images and may decrease with heavy JPEG compression or social media re-encoding.
source: Digital image forensics research. Based on signal processing and computational photography principles.
useCase: Detection of AI-generated or manipulated images through linear pattern detection analysis. This method identifies patterns and artifacts that are characteristic of AI generation, contributing to a comprehensive image forensic analysis.
strengths:
• Fast client-side processing using Canvas API
• Effective at detecting specific AI generation artifacts
• Works with common image formats (JPEG, PNG, WebP)
• Can be combined with complementary analysis methods
• Based on established image forensics research
limitations:
• Performance may vary with image compression level
• Social media re-encoding can affect accuracy
• Best used in combination with other forensic methods
• May produce false positives on heavily processed authentic images
• Effectiveness depends on the AI generation model used

references.title: Fridrich, J. & Kodovsky, J. (2012). Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images. IEEE TIFS.
Wang, S.Y. et al. (2020). CNN-generated images are surprisingly easy to spot. CVPR.
